text:
maria_cust: Hey team, we're seeing duplicated order records after upstream 429 spikes. Using the Python SDK 0.9.1. Quick repro below — sometimes a request gets retried and the server processes it twice (no idempotency). Logs show 429 then a retry but the Idempotency-Key header is missing on the retry.

Repro script:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import uuid
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"sk-REDACTED\")
for i in range(3):
    key = str(uuid.uuid4())
    res = client.post('/orders', json={ 'item': 'socks' }, headers={ 'Idempotency-Key': key })
    print(i, res.status_code, res.json())
```

Snippet from our app log around a duplicate:
```
2024-07-22T15:20:10Z INFO request id=abc123 status=429 body={"error":"rate_limited"}
2024-07-22T15:20:10Z INFO retrying request id=abc123 attempt=2
2024-07-22T15:20:10Z INFO outbound-headers {"Authorization":"Bearer sk-REDACTED"}   <-- Idempotency-Key missing
2024-07-22T15:20:10Z INFO response id=abc123 status=201 order_id=ord_789
```

Any idea what's happening? We're running under Gunicorn + gevent workers (preload_app = False).

josh_support: Sorry you're hitting this, thanks for the repro. Can you confirm the exact SDK package list and whether you're using multiprocessing / pre-fork server mode? Also, do you set any global session or request hook?

maria_cust: pip freeze: `redwood==0.9.1`, `requests==2.31.0`, `gunicorn==21.2.0`, `gevent==22.10.2`. We do use gunicorn with pre-fork workers, but not preload. No custom request hooks. We put the Idempotency-Key in the headers on the call as shown.

josh_support: Thanks — pinging SDK team, tagging @dave_sdk. :eyes:

retry-bot: Automated note: created support ticket RWD-1227 for duplicate-order reports (severity: medium).

carol_eng: @maria_cust can you reproduce with a minimal single-process script (outside gunicorn) to rule out worker-specific issues? If not, please include whether threads or forking are used.

maria_cust: I tried on a single process (python3 repro.py) and I can reproduce ~1/20 runs. I added verbose logging on headers in the SDK and see that the initial attempt includes `Idempotency-Key` but the retry shows headers only containing `Authorization` and `User-Agent`. Looks nondeterministic.

carol_eng: That's helpful. Can you paste the raw SDK debug trace? Even the small snippet helps.

maria_cust: Here's the SDK debug snippet (redacted keys):
```
[SDK] -> POST /orders headers={"Authorization": "Bearer sk-REDACTED", "Idempotency-Key": "4f2b..."}
[SDK] <= 429 retryable
[SDK] retry sleep jitter=0.037s
[SDK] -> POST /orders headers={"Authorization": "Bearer sk-REDACTED"}   # Idempotency-Key missing here
[SDK] <= 201 order_id=ord_789
```

dave_sdk: Thanks for the detailed repro and logs — this looks like idempotency header loss inside the retry path. We're triaging. A few Qs: 1) are you using the client across threads/processes? 2) any monkeypatching of random/jitter or seeding? The jitter implementation used to reseed per-thread in 0.9.1 which could race with header cloning in the retry coordinator.

maria_cust: We don't manually seed RNG. We do create the RedwoodClient at module import and reuse it across requests. Single-process repro still shows the issue occasionally.

dave_sdk: Reproduced locally in a small harness — thanks. Root cause: when a retry triggers we clone the request state but inadvertently drop per-call headers if the jitter reseed path modifies the internal RetryState object while headers are being shallow-copied. Race in the shallow copy -> header dict gets replaced.

dave_sdk: Short-term workaround: pass the idempotency key via the explicit parameter `idempotency_key=` on the call (we'll preserve that field on retry), or manually set `REDWOOD_RETRY_DETERMINISTIC=false` in your env to avoid the reseed behavior. Example:
```python
client.post('/orders', json={...}, idempotency_key=key)
```

josh_support: Added reproducible case to tracker rwd/sdk#1234 and escalated to eng. Workaround noted for the customer.

carol_eng: We're preparing a patch to ensure headers are deepcopied and immutable during retry cloning. Will include a unit test that simulates concurrent jitter reseed + retry.

dave_sdk: Patch is merged to main (PR rwd/sdk#214), we've changed the retry flow to deep-copy request metadata and to keep `idempotency_key` sticky. We'll cut a patch release v0.9.3 with the fix. ETA: today.

maria_cust: Awesome, thanks — good to have a targeted fix. Do you expect any config changes on our side after we upgrade?

dave_sdk: No config changes required. After upgrading to 0.9.3 your existing headers and explicit `idempotency_key` usage will be preserved across retries. If you can't upgrade immediately, use the workaround above.

josh_support: Patch released: v0.9.3 published to PyPI. Please upgrade and confirm. We're keeping this ticket open for 48h to validate. :thumbsup:

maria_cust: Upgraded and tested a few hundred runs — no duplicates so far. Thanks everyone! Closing on our side.

dave_sdk: Thanks for the quick verification. Closing support ticket RWD-1227. If you see a recurrence, reopen here and we'll re-investigate.
